name: Telluric-Shoal
description: Heat is the local god. Fissures glow along every fault line, the air tastes of sulfur past crystal cavern networks, and by dark the ground itself still glows faintly, like a banked furnace.
In the calm seasons the world feels almost kind, which veterans say is exactly when it takes the careless.
Core samples from the deep crust contain isotopes with no known decay chain. The samples are stored off-world now, and studied reluctantly.
Survey contracts pay double for reasons nobody writes down. Veterans read the fine print, then read the survivors.
